frequency_question: How often do declared strike ballots or final ultimatum deadlines by national banking union federations result in an indefinite strike within 12 days?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike calls by major national banking union coalitions (like UFBU or similar multi-union bodies) where a specific deadline or window is set; excludes local or single-bank enterprise strikes.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association strike Nov 2023

coverage_note: 5 major national banking union strike escalations examined; 3 proceeded to strike action within the target window.
